versions.content: In case of a transmit request for a SoAdPduRoute that refers to a global PDU structure configured with a MetaDataItem of the type SOCKET_CONNECTION_ID_16 and the contained SoAdPduRouteDest refers to a socket connection g roup, SoAd shall only perform the transmission on the socket connection identified by PduInfoType.MetaDataPtr instead of the whole group.
